concerns.text: Task T040 (retrieval‑latency extraction) is scheduled after the entire simulation suite (T029‑T038). Since it modifies `code/simulate_sessions.py`, the earlier simulation tasks will run without the new `retrieval_latency` column, violating the data‑flow that downstream tasks (e.g., T042, T054) expect. Move T040 before any simulation tasks (preferably before T029) so the column is present in all result files.

Task T059 (quickstart.md) is placed before T039a (pipeline wrapper). The quickstart documentation references the command `python -m code.run_pipeline`, which does not exist until T039a creates `code/run_pipeline.py`. This consumer‑before‑producer ordering will cause the quickstart guide to be inaccurate. Reorder so T039a precedes T059.
